figurative_meaning_en: Similar to cutting off the head, implying a severe or self-destructive action
similar_in_english: Cut off one's nose to spite one's face
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই সিদ্ধান্ত নিলে তুমি নিজের মাথা খোঁড়া করবে।
সে তার ভুলের জন্য মাথা খোঁড়া করেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Taking this decision will be like digging your own head.
He has dug his own head with that mistake.
note: This idiom draws from imagery of self-harm or digging a pit for one's head, akin to fatal mistakes in Bengali folklore.
